description: This file defines the main shell widget for the authenticated part of a Flutter app. It implements bottom tab navigation with four tabs (Home, Search, Favorites, Profile), manages the current tab state, and includes a FloatingActionButton to navigate to an AddRecipeScreen.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: Main shell widget providing tab navigation and FAB after user login.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class for HomeShell, manages the current tab index and UI layout.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeShell widget.

methods.name: _onTab
methods.description: Updates the current tab index when a tab is selected.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeShell, including AppBar, IndexedStack, FAB, and BottomNavigationBar.
